## Routing Decisions for Chapter 5B — Economic Wellbeing

**Source:** CIDOB political biography of Andrés Manuel López Obrador (BOOK-013)
**Period covered:** Up to August 2018 (inauguration; no presidential implementation period in source)
**Scope:** All 67 chunk decisions returned

---

| **U0063** | 5B.1, 5B.3, 5B.6, 5B.8, 5B.9, 5B.10 | Comprehensive social-economic commitments: 6% growth, 1.2 million jobs/year, food-sovereignty, minimum-wage trajectory, public housing, universal education/health, senior pensions, security rooted in social causes — strongest single passage for the chapter; NAFTA renegotiation context for 5B.9 | U0062 opens the 2018 platform; U0064 opens the campaign narrative |

### Scope Note

The CIDOB biography covers López Obrador's career through the 2018 election victory and stops at August 2018, prior to any presidential implementation. All included chunks carry the 5B lens citations but are predominantly **campaign promises and programmatic declarations** rather than implemented policy outcomes. For 5B.7 (credible data, independent audit) and 5B.9 (shock response), the source provides only pre-inauguration policy intentions. No chunk covers enacted budgets, actual appointments, implementation failures, or adaptive corrections during a presidential term — these require mid- or end-period evidence absent from this source.
